Description
Canadian Maple Leaf Gold Coin
is considered to be one of the most beautiful gold coins in the world. 1-ounce Canadian maple leaf coins are the first gold bullion coins minted by the
Royal Canadian  Mint
. Each Canadian Maple leaf is guaranteed by the Royal Canadian Mint, for its purity and weight. Since its release in 1979, the 1 oz maple leaf gold coin has become popular among investors and collectors due to its design and purity. The Canadian Maple Leaf Gold Coin was first produced in 1979 and was the first pure 24k gold bullion coin in the world. The 22k South African Krugerrand was the only gold coin commonly available at the time.
The 1 oz Random Year Canadian Maple Leaf Gold Coins comes from the excess of the inventory so there is no guarantee on which year’s gold coin you will receive. The Maple Leaf Gold Coins minted from 1979 to 1982 have a gold purity content of .999 fine, while those produced after 1980-82 have a gold purity content of .9999 fine.
These coins may have slight abrasions/marks or general signs of wear and tear. This does not effect the purity of the gold. These are ideal for the those that wish to invest in gold itself  and offers a more affordable way with lower premiums from the outset. Coins will be from 1980 onwards.
Terminology of
abrasion
: Marks or small scratches on the surface of a coin where another coin or object has slid across or bumped the coin. Sometimes the terms “scuffing,” “light rubbing,” or “hairlines” are also used to indicate light abrasive wear.
Design of 1 oz Canadian Maple Leaf Gold Coin .999 or .9999 Random Year (Abrasions/Marks)
The 1 oz Canadian Maple Leaf Gold Coin features the beautiful portrayal of Her Majesty, Queen Elizabeth II along with the year and face value on the obverse. There have been different portraits of Her Majesty throughout her long reign, so the portraits may be different according to the minting year.
The 1 ounce Canadian gold maple leaf coin features iconic Canada’s national symbol of the maple leaf along with its vein along with gold coins purity and the weight.
Main Highlights of 1 oz Canadian Maple Leaf Gold Coin .999 or .9999 Random Year (Abrasions/Marks)
Contains 1 troy oz of

Features the Right-facing profile of her Majesty, Queen Elizabeth II  on the obverse.
Features Canada’s national emblem of a maple leaf with purity and weight on reverse.
The weight and purity of the gold coin are guaranteed by the Royal Canadian Mint.
